hints.title: Tree Path Extraction
hints.text: Trace the unique simple path between the query endpoints in the undirected tree.

hints.title: Contiguous Subpath Bitwise Evaluation
hints.text: Enumerate the bitwise exclusive or sum for every contiguous subpath along the linear path sequence.

hints.title: Kth Element Selection
hints.text: Sort the collected subpath values in ascending order and select the kth 1-indexed entry.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Breadth-first path extraction followed by subpath enumeration and sorting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining non-path tree branches causes exponential redundant state generation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linearizing the path vertices allows simple triangular loops for subpath sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Isolate the path between nodes and generate subpath XOR sums iteratively.
